purpose: Retain all C05 edits. Add the existing flash selector to SelfShot MENU without dropping existing items; add the existing Flash item as a fourth Fn row; enable only SelfShot native Fn flash values 0,4,5,6,7. Based on C05 hardware feedback with the original 9mm lens: flash absent in both MENU and Fn. UI rendering and physical flash are still unverified.

operations.reason: Remove only the detached-lens S2 interception branch. The following independent 0x464 lens-fault query still executes.
Remove only the detached-lens branch inside original readiness; the following independent 0x464 fault query and other readiness conditions remain.
Take the original nolens-enabled path for detached event 2 without changing the global physical lens state.
Take the original nolens-enabled path for detached event 6 used at capture completion.

The common CAeLensIF initialize/detach default has IrisDrive=0 but advertises 21 aperture nodes. Keep only its first node. The native lens-data loader subsequently replaces the count and table with received data.

In the lower-mode fallback of CMenuFlash, R0 is UI mode minus 0x2002. R1=5-R0 makes only previously unhandled SelfShot 0x2006 join the original full-option branch; all other 16-bit mode option lists are preserved. Native lens/drive/HDR availability guards remain.

operations.reason: The native Manual AE path is used by Smart Auto scene 0x12 after a fixed AV=96 preset and bypasses table quantization. Replace a side-effect-free discarded EV calculation and dead comparison with the original AV/TV compensator only when the aperture table has one node. Preserve zeroing of bytes 6/7 via one halfword store. Multi-node tables skip the compensator.
Increase only the SelfShot MENU iterator from 9 to 10 items.
Prefix the existing SelfShot MENU table with the adjacent original Program flash selector 10, preserving all 9 existing items.
Preserve r6 instead of caller-saved r3 in the SelfShot Fn layout stack frame, maintaining 24-byte stack alignment.
Increase only the SelfShot Fn layout from 3 rows to 4 within the native 5 by 4 grid.
Preserve the original 12 cells, then add the existing flash item across row 3. Reuse the original title, focus finalizer and return; replace only the SelfShot layout log tail, without a code cave.
RSB r2,r1,#5 routes only SelfShot 0x2006 to existing Fn flash values 0,4,5,6,7; compare all 16-bit modes.

rollback: Restore the SHA-verified official 1.10 firmware using the normal updater if accessible. C05 backup may also be retained as the previously user-tested candidate. Disassembled recovery is documented but not tested on this camera.
